gaps.units_within_printed_range: The courses' units as read fall within the printed range of units rather than matching it.
gaps.waived_course_counted: The page prints a requirement at a range from zero units, since a student may meet it without the course (a certification, an exam or earlier coursework), and the record counts the course, so its units match the top of the printed range and not its low end.

held.why: held: the page itself prints one course under 'Two courses from the following:' (FTVM 112) and two under 'Four courses from the following:' (FTVM 213, THART 131), over 'Total Units 24-25' (college-page-read run 45835049303), so no reading adds its lists to the printed total; no filed kind names a list shorter than its count, and a new kind is shared code: the follow-up's

Today's scorer passes the record without the state's list, and a record it passes is never gap-filed: a reconcile step for the pair's printed figure, or a scorer change, the follow-up's

held: its filed arithmetic is an older scorer's (the major's 50-60 against the printed 50-63). claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
